hardware.tested_state: current esp32 main head flashed after companion serial smoke tooling

procedure: Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py, ESP-IDF v5.5.4, and /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 before building.
Ran make idf-build in NostrSeal/esp32; the app version was 8307c4b and the binary size was 0x8e850 with 0x717b0 bytes free in the app partition.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash and verified bootloader, app, and partition table write hashes through esptool.
Ran NostrSeal/lab hardware_companion_serial_smoke.py sign-event-disabled through the companion request-bound serial path.
expected_result: The current esp32 main head builds, flashes, passes capability and review-scenario USB serial smokes, and still rejects companion-generated sign_event requests with signing_disabled.
observed_result: The current-head firmware built and flashed successfully on the attached LILYGO T-Display S3. idf-smoke-capabilities passed with 39 verified exchanges, 9 response frames, and 30 expected rejection frames. idf-smoke-review-scenarios passed with 7 scenarios, 8 verified exchanges, 7 response frames, and 1 expected rejection frame. The companion sign-event-disabled smoke sent request_id lab-companion-head-sign-event-disabled and received error.code signing_disabled through request-bound unwrap.
limitations: This is protocol and disabled-signing smoke for the current development firmware head.
This is not a new manual visual display inspection.

This does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification for real signatures, or real signing.
sign_event remains signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
